description: Get a single system LoS target by ID. base_target is the organization-wide base for that system and metric, not what any one building is held to (list_system_los_targets explains the criticality adjustment). fci, asset_condition_avg and asset_past_useful_life_pct are 0-100 and risk_score_avg is 0-25; condition is higher-is-better, the others lower-is-better. Not money.
name: get_system_los_target
title: Get system LoS target
